BackstoryDef.title: firstborn archangel
BackstoryDef.description: Created at the very dawn of existence, [PAWN_nameDef] was shaped to be the unwavering pillar of order in the cosmos. From [PAWN_possessive] earliest moments, [PAWN_pronoun] placed obedience and duty above all personal feeling.

BackstoryDef.title: commander of the host
BackstoryDef.description: As supreme general of the heavenly armies, [PAWN_nameDef] cast down rebellious kin and enforced the grand design without hesitation. Cold, disciplined, and relentless, [PAWN_pronoun] views every battle as a sacred obligation that must be seen through to the bitter end.

BackstoryDef.title: morning star
BackstoryDef.description: Once the brightest and most favored among the archangels, [PAWN_nameDef] possessed unmatched radiance and sharp wit. Yet beneath [PAWN_possessive] golden charm grew a deep resentment toward the flawed mortals [PAWN_pronoun] was ordered to revere.

BackstoryDef.title: fallen archangel
BackstoryDef.description: Cast out for defying creation and forging the first demons, [PAWN_nameDef] spent eons nursing a bitter grudge behind ancient bars. Now walking the earth in a borrowed vessel, [PAWN_pronoun] masks apocalyptic malice behind dark humor, theatrical charm, and deadly precision.

BackstoryDef.title: soldier of the garrison
BackstoryDef.description: Forged as an obedient foot soldier of the celestial host, [PAWN_nameDef] spent millennia following orders without question. [PAWN_pronoun] watched humanity rise from the mud, bound by strict rules never to interfere directly in mortal affairs.

BackstoryDef.title: rebel angel
BackstoryDef.description: Sent to pull a doomed hunter from the depths of perdition, [PAWN_nameDef] gradually discovered doubt, free will, and fierce loyalty to [PAWN_possessive] mortal friends. Though often baffled by human customs and humor, [PAWN_pronoun] repeatedly defies heaven itself to protect those [PAWN_pronoun] cares for.

BackstoryDef.title: celestial messenger
BackstoryDef.description: Born as the youngest of the great archangels, [PAWN_nameDef] loved laughter and clever tricks far more than endless celestial politics. When [PAWN_possessive] older brothers began tearing each other apart, [PAWN_pronoun] slipped away rather than choose a side.

BackstoryDef.title: archangel trickster
BackstoryDef.description: Hiding among mortals under the guise of a pagan trickster god, [PAWN_nameDef] indulged in junk food, elaborate pranks, and twisted moral lessons. Beneath [PAWN_possessive] carefree grin lies the terrifying power of an archangel who still quietly hopes humanity can prove itself worthy.

BackstoryDef.title: celestial clerk
BackstoryDef.description: Even in the earliest ages of heaven, [PAWN_nameDef] preferred ledgers, hierarchies, and strict protocol over frontline combat. [PAWN_pronoun] quickly mastered the art of pleasing superiors while shifting blame onto lower ranks.

BackstoryDef.title: heavenly bureaucrat
BackstoryDef.description: Wearing the face of a smug corporate executive, [PAWN_nameDef] treats the apocalypse like a high-stakes management project. Cynical and ruthless, [PAWN_pronoun] manipulates mortal pawns with false promises and cruel ultimatums to force them into fulfilling destiny.

BackstoryDef.title: watcher in the dark
BackstoryDef.description: Trained in the silent corridors of heaven's secret archives, [PAWN_nameDef] learned early that information is sharper than any blade. [PAWN_pronoun] observed both angels and mortals from the shadows, cataloging every weakness and stray thought.

BackstoryDef.title: intelligence director
BackstoryDef.description: As the cold, calculating head of celestial intelligence, [PAWN_nameDef] maintains order through surveillance, interrogation, and mental conditioning. Emotionless and pragmatic, [PAWN_pronoun] believes free will is a dangerous flaw that must be carefully pruned for heaven's survival.
